backlog.title: Per-Role Reasoning Level (Extended-Thinking Budget)
backlog.description: Make the extended-thinking ('reasoning') budget a first-class, independently-configurable per-role setting, fully decoupled from model (tier) selection. Five roles, each controlled by one PRP_REASONING_<ROLE> env var (vocabulary off/minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh, case-insensitive), resolved through the §9.2.1 layer stack, validated fail-fast at startup, and surfaced in .hack + hack config show --src. Implements PRD §9.2.9 (new) plus conforming edits to §6.1, §9.2.2, §9.2.3, §9.5, §9.7.5. Architectural ground truth is in plan/013_3f31aa2b81b7/architecture/ (system-context.md, integration-points.md, external-deps.md) — all change sites verified by direct read. Groundswell harness-side --thinking wiring is a cross-repo dependency (OUT OF SCOPE); this phase stops at storing the resolved level on AgentConfig.thinking.

milestones.title: Reasoning Config & Agent Wiring (the feature)
milestones.description: The complete per-role reasoning feature: vocabulary + getters + fail-fast validator (T1), .hack schema wiring (T2), agent-factory decoupling + shared-QA-persona split (T3), and startup fail-fast integration + config show --src (T4). Model (tier) resolution is UNCHANGED; only the reasoning axis is decoupled and made per-identity.
